service.description: Internal: the account of a username (compared without case) and whether it may sign in (not disabled, not past its disabledDateTime).
Internal: the SCRAM-SHA-256 salt, iteration count and verifiers of a user's app passwords (UserAppPassword.scram*), base64; nothing for an unknown or disabled user.

parameter.name: appPasswordIdList
parameter.description: The app password of each verifier

service.description: Internal: SASL PLAIN, with an app password only (never the account password, whose failures would count toward its lockout and which cannot carry a second factor). An error when it does not match.

Internal: whether a signed-in XMPP session may go on: the account may still sign in (get#Account's canLogin) and the app password it signed in with (appPasswordId) is the user's and not revoked. The session asks every minute and ends when valid is false.

actions.script: valid = false const account = ec.entity.find('moqui.security.UserAccount').condition('userId', userId).disableAuthz().one() if (!account || !appPasswordId) return const until = account.disabledDateTime ? Number(account.disabledDateTime) : null if (account.disabled === 'Y' && !(until != null && until < Number(ec.user.nowTimestamp))) return const password = ec.entity.find('moqui.security.UserAppPassword').condition('appPasswordId', appPasswordId).disableAuthz().one() valid = !!password && password.userId === userId && !password.revokedDate

service.description: Internal: the unexpired FAST tokens of a user's client (userAgentId), decrypted, for the HMAC check; not one whose app password was revoked.
Internal: keep a new FAST token for a user's client, in place of the one it had, under the app password the client signed in with; out expiry (XEP-0082).

actions.script: ec.entity.find('moqui.xmpp.XmppFastToken').condition('userId', userId).condition('userAgentId', userAgentId).disableAuthz().deleteAll() const expires = new Date(Number(ec.user.nowTimestamp) + Number(lifetimeSeconds) * 1000) const row = ec.entity.makeValue('moqui.xmpp.XmppFastToken') row.setSequencedIdPrimary() row.setFields({userId: userId, userAgentId: userAgentId, appPasswordId: appPasswordId, mechanism: mechanism, token: token, lastCount: -1, createdDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp, expireDate: expires}, true, null, null) row.create() expiry = expires.toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/, 'Z')

service.description: Internal: a FAST token signed in. Without channel binding (bound false) its count must be higher than any before, so a captured exchange is not replayed; an error when it is not.

actions.script: ec.entity.find('moqui.xmpp.XmppFastToken').condition('fastTokenId', fastTokenId).disableAuthz().deleteAll()

service.description: Usernames of userIds, or userIds of usernames (compared without case): the JIDs of the people the current user meets in chat. An external user (EXTERNAL_USER) learns only of the people of their own rooms.
The roster of the current user: the other members of their direct rooms.
The direct room of the current user and another user, made when there is none (ChatServices.create#Room).
A room the current user may read, for its XMPP view: the room (with encrypted, the C7 flag, when the field is there), whether it is bridged, and its local members with their usernames and roles.

Messages for XMPP history (XEP-0313, and a room's join history): of chatRoomId (a room the user may read), else of the user's direct rooms (withUserId: the one with that user), merged by time. afterSeq and beforeSeq page by eventSeq (with afterRoomId and beforeRoomId in the user's own archive, where the date of that event is the bound); startDate and endDate (Unix milliseconds) limit by time; latest gives the last limit messages. Each message as get#Timeline has it (edits applied, deleted ones left out), with clientRef for every sender and, for an OMEMO message, content.xmppEncrypted. complete says nothing is past the page in its direction; count is the total.

An event of a room the user may read, by eventSeq or by the clientRef its sender gave it: its eventSeq, clientRef and sender, and the active reactions on it of the current user (myReactions) and of reactorUserId (reactorReactions).

An OMEMO message (XEP-0384, either namespace) from an XMPP client: kept as it came, as a message Moqui cannot read (content.xmppEncrypted {xml, namespace}, and a notice as its body for the web), with no bodyText, snippet, search, mentions or agent delivery. Refused in a room with a bridge (its networks would get nothing they could read) and in an end-to-end encrypted Moqui room (C7). A clientRef the sender used before in the room answers that message.

The items of a PEP node of ownerUserId (the current user by default) that the current user may read: open (any user), presence (the people the owner shares a room with), whitelist (the owner). itemIdList picks items; maxItems the newest that many. exists false for a node that is not there; denied true when it may not be read. The bookmarks node (urn:xmpp:bookmarks:1) of the user's own adds the user's group rooms as bookmarks with autojoin, where the user kept none for them.

The users who may read a user's PEP node with accessModel: everyone for open (returned as the user's room co-members, the ones who would be notified), the co-members for presence, the user alone for whitelist.

Publish an item to one of the current user's PEP nodes, made on first publish with options (access_model, max_items; persist_items is always true). A node that exists keeps its options: a publish whose access_model or max_items differs is not made (preconditionFailed true, XEP-0060 §7.1.5). A user has at most 200 nodes, each with at most 256 items (the oldest go). Out the users to notify (notifyUserIdList, who may read it).
Change one of the current user's PEP nodes' access_model or max_items (pubsub#owner configure).

actions.script: jidList = Array.from(ec.entity.find('moqui.xmpp.XmppBlockedJid').condition('userId', ec.user.userId).disableAuthz().list()).map((row) => row.jid)

service.description: Unblock the JIDs of jidList, or all of them when it is empty.
Keep a client's push registration (XEP-0357): its app server and node, and its options (with the app server's secret), encrypted. The same app server and node replace the one before.

actions.script: const me = ec.user.userId ec.entity.find('moqui.xmpp.XmppPushRegistration').condition('userId', me).condition('pushJid', pushJid).condition('node', node || null).disableAuthz().deleteAll() const row = ec.entity.makeValue('moqui.xmpp.XmppPushRegistration') row.setSequencedIdPrimary() row.setFields({userId: me, pushJid: String(pushJid).slice(0, 250), node: node ? String(node).slice(0, 250) : null, resource: resource || null, optionsJson: JSON.stringify(options || {}), createdDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp}, true, null, null) row.create()

service.description: Remove the current user's registrations with the app server pushJid (and node, when given).
Internal: a user's push registrations, decrypted, for a notification.

An upload slot (XEP-0363) for the current user: a token whose URL takes one PUT of fileSize bytes (no more than xmpp_upload_max_bytes) within an hour. A user gets at most 60 slots an hour, asking for at most ten times xmpp_upload_max_bytes in all. Out the token and the file name as it goes in the URL.

A file the current user put to an upload slot, linked from a message to a room they may post in: made a chat file of that room (a ChatAttachment on the same stored file), for send#Message's chatAttachmentIdList. Out its chatAttachmentId.

The URLs an XMPP client fetches a message's files at, for a room the current user may read: the upload URL for a file put over XMPP, else one made for the chat file, its token derived from the file and the secret xmpp_upload_secret (the same for every reader, so a message has one URL).
Daily: upload slots never put within an hour go, with their files, and so do expired FAST tokens. Each on its own: one that cannot be removed is logged and the rest go on.

What the current user enters in an XMPP app (basic-comms Settings, Chat apps): enabled (xmpp_domain is set), jid (the username in lower case, escaped as XEP-0106 has it, at the domain), server (the domain), port (STARTTLS, xmpp_port) and tlsPort (direct TLS, xmpp_tls_port), each empty while off, and websocketUrl (/xmpp-websocket with xmpp_websocket_enabled); and appPasswordList, the user's app passwords (UserServices.get#UserAppPasswords) each with xmppReady: one made before XMPP sign-in (C3a) has no SCRAM verifiers, and most apps need a new one. Behind an edge node the ports are still this node's own: the edge node's tunnel ports (edge_xmpp_port, edge_xmpp_tls_port) are given the same numbers (docs/interfaces/XMPP.md).

External services (XEP-0215) for the current user's own Jingle calls: the TURN URLs of a live media node and turn_external_urls, with a credential keyed to the user (make#IceServers with callLegId xmpp.(userId)), each as type, host, port, transport, username, password and expires. The embedded TURN server relays such a credential to public addresses only (docs/interfaces/TURN.md). Empty, with reasonCode, while xmpp_turn_enabled is not true (turnOff), for an external user (EXTERNAL_USER; a failed check counts as external: notAllowed), and past xmpp_turn_per_hour (30) issues to the user in the hour (rateLimited); the session answers each the same.
